objective: Run the frozen four-case semantic worthiness treatment on Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6-thinking after clearing the local benchmark transport gate.
finding: Both models completed all four cases and recovered 100% of required evidence. Sonnet had 91.67% role accuracy, 75% temporal accuracy, 58.33% admission accuracy; Opus had 83.33% role accuracy, 75% temporal accuracy, 75% admission accuracy. TU-04 was the dominant failure seam for both.
decision: Do not declare a semantic-model winner from four cases. Preserve the frozen prompt and scoring and expand to 16 cases before model/prompt tuning.
next_step: Freeze richer 16-case semantic gold audit and rerun both candidates on the same protocol.
